Work with Us!

Breadcrumb

  1. Home
  2. About UNSSC
  3. Work With Us!
Share on

The Staff College is a vibrant and innovative community and we are always on the lookout for talented individuals who share our values. We are growing and evolving, but can only do this with the help of our staff and course participants. Whether you're starting or continuing your career, explore how you can work with us at one of our two campuses.

The UNSSC does not accept unsolicited applications for jobs.
